description: What one frame of the main loop runs. hooks: named engine steps run at each fixed point of the frame (startup once before the first frame, then top, input, after_update, late, sync, after_swap, after_present), in list order; the engine's own steps (soft-reset checks, game state update, frame pacing, buffer swap, end-of-frame draw) run between them. An unknown hook name is reported and skipped. opaque_depth_rooms: map rooms whose world drawing tests opaque depth because their draw order overlaps. black_void_cutscene_maps: maps whose cutscenes clear the screen to black. ui_menu_game_states / ui_menu_sys_states: game and system states whose menu drawing switches to the 4:3 frame once the world is off screen and the fade is not opaque. A mod changes it with a file of the same path in its own folder; objects are merged key by key, so the patch only needs the keys it changes.
